items.html: *And it has already been explained above that these thirteen are three Names of Sag (63). However, at many other times I heard from my teacher, may his memory be for a blessing, that they are all Names of Ab (72) with the filling of Yods; and he said that every aspect of the head of Arich Anpin is Names of Yods; and it requires examination, as above. And with this you will understand what is said in Idra Rabba, page 128, side B: "And in each and every lock there are four hundred and ten locks of hair, according to the holy reckoning, etc." And the reason is that, since the root of these three Names of the thirteen locks is of Yods, therefore the locks that issue from them are four hundred and ten, in the aforementioned manner, for the four Yods that are in each Name are four hundred, and the root of the ten themselves, making four hundred and ten. And similarly, if you join the ten letters of the filling of Yods with the four hundred, it will be four hundred and ten.
